elements.description: The / and @ picker for a text field the app owns: grouped results, arrow keys, ↵ / Tab inserts a token or a chip.

properties.name: htmlFor
properties.description: The id of the field to attach to (in the same document)

properties.name: target
properties.description: The field to attach to – wins over `for`

properties.name: triggers
properties.description: The trigger characters and what each one offers

properties.name: search
properties.description: Finds suggestions in place of the built-in filter (see MentionPickerSearch)

properties.name: renderChip
properties.description: Builds the chip for a contenteditable field (see MentionPickerRenderChip)

properties.name: placement
properties.description: "auto" opens below the trigger, or above it when there's more room there

properties.name: emptyText
properties.description: What the list says when nothing matches

properties.name: attached
properties.description: The field it is attached to

properties.name: look
properties.description: Visual style: "standard" or "clean"; unset follows <tc-look-provider>, else "standard"

events.name: tc-pick
events.description: A row was picked (`MentionPickerPick`: `{ item, trigger, query, token }`). Cancelable: preventDefault() leaves the field as it is – the app inserts the mention itself

events.name: tc-open-change
events.description: The list opened or closed (`{ open, trigger, query }`)

events.name: tc-query-change
events.description: The text after the trigger changed while open (`{ query, trigger }`)

methods.name: close
methods.description: Closes the list (it opens again when the next trigger is typed)

props.name: target
props.description: The field to attach to: an element or a ref to one (a <textarea>, an <input> or a contenteditable element)

props.name: triggers
props.description: The trigger characters and what each one offers – icons may be React nodes

props.name: onPick
props.description:
Called with the pick. The picker then puts a token (textarea, input) or a chip (contenteditable) in place of the
typed query – call `event.preventDefault()` to insert it yourself instead

props.name: onOpenChange
props.description: Called when the list opens or closes, with the trigger character it opened for (null when closed)

props.name: onQueryChange
props.description: Called when the text typed after the trigger changes while the list is open

changelog: `tc-mention-picker` – the / and @ picker for a textarea, input or contenteditable: grouped, scored results, the field keeps focus (aria-activedescendant), ↵ / Tab insert a token or a chip, and the composer's Enter-to-send never sees that ↵. `search` may be async.

chat-composer (the Lit element and `trenchcoat/react`): opt-in `mentions` (a `tc-mention-picker` on the message) and `context` / `context-limit` (a `tc-context-tray` above it). Without them it renders as before.

features.name: light-dark()
features.why: Every colour token is a light / dark pair; without it no colour token resolves.

features.name: color-mix()
features.why: Tints and washes mixed from the tokens.

features.name: :is() and :where()
features.why: Every rule is keyed on :where() so the page can override it.

features.name: scrollbar-width
features.without: Scrollbars keep the browser's default width.

features.name: Popover API
features.without: Lists open fixed to the window instead of in the top layer, so a clipping ancestor or a modal can cover them.

features.name: adoptedStyleSheets
features.without: Each element type's CSS goes into one <style> element in <head> instead – it looks and works the same.

features.name: forced-colors media query
features.without: In a forced-colours mode the browser's own adjustments apply, without the components' fixes.

features.name: overscroll-behavior: contain
features.without: Scrolling past the end of a list carries on scrolling the page.
